study: HSTU paper-era public reproduction and GPU characterization v1
status: Frozen before data preparation, model execution, or GPU yield

scope.primary_question: Can the first public Meta HSTU release reproduce its released MovieLens-1M next-item results against its matched SASRec baseline, and what are the measured model-versus-kernel costs on an A100?
non_goals: Reproducing Meta private trillion-parameter models, private features, streaming data, online A/B tests, or business metrics
Treating the public MovieLens task as production ranking
Relabeling prior SilverTorch, MS MARCO, KuaiRand, TorchRec, or query-adaptation outcomes
Inventing serving QPS, p99 SLOs, MFU, energy, causal parameter-count effects, or million-item evidence

paper.title: Actions Speak Louder than Words: Trillion-Parameter Sequential Transducers for Generative Recommendations
paper.publication: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235:58484-58509, 2024

paper_era_code.policy: All 43 upstream files remain byte-identical; runtime controls live outside the vendored tree.

later_code_review.use: Historical and separately labeled kernel comparison only; never substituted for the paper-era model reproduction.

released: MovieLens-1M, MovieLens-20M, and Amazon Books preprocessing
Sampled-softmax training and exhaustive full-catalog evaluation
not_released_at_the_pin: Optimized HSTU kernels used for the paper throughput figures
Private data, checkpoints, trillion-parameter configurations, and load generators
later_additions: Triton ragged HSTU attention beginning in later 2024 history
CUDA/Hopper attention kernels and DLRMv3 in later revisions
HSTU Ultra and FP8 paths added in 2026

environment.hardware: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, one task-owned GPU per paper-era training run
environment.isolation: Task-owned uv environment under node-local scratch; no mutation of the shared base image.
environment.readme_deviation: The unpinned paper-era README lists Apex and broad scientific packages. Apex is not imported by the released execution path and is omitted rather than installing an arbitrary ABI-sensitive build.

primary.name: MovieLens-1M
primary.license: Research use with attribution; no redistribution or commercial use without permission.
primary.split: For each user, training drops the latest interaction and predicts next items throughout the remaining chronological sequence; evaluation predicts the latest interaction from prior history.
primary.semantics: Every rating event is treated as an interaction/positive next-item target by the released loss; rating value is not used to filter training supervision.
primary.catalog: All 3883 rows in movies.dat, including 3706 items observed in ratings; exhaustive evaluation excludes prior history.

secondary_scale_probes.name: MovieLens-20M
secondary_scale_probes.purpose: Real 20,000,263-event sequence-scale probe with 26,744 released-code items; not a million-item catalog.
secondary_scale_probes.gate: Run only after the primary reproduction is durable and a measured one-epoch estimate fits a finite four-hour execution cap.

secondary_scale_probes.name: Amazon Books
secondary_scale_probes.purpose: Released-code catalog probe with expected 695,762 retained items, still below one million.
secondary_scale_probes.gate: Preprocess and audit first; admit at most one fixed epoch only if download/preparation and measured throughput fit a finite four-hour execution cap.
secondary_scale_probes.required_adapter: Remove the stale train_fn.item_feature_embedding_dim binding from the first-public-commit Gin file, matching upstream repair commit 88acd0308bb549e005ae6532ee54585457e1b4a4. Preserve and report this deviation.

training.negative_sampling: 128 uniform local catalog negatives per positive
training.seed_adapter: scripts/hstu/sitecustomize.py seeds Python, NumPy, and PyTorch in every launched interpreter without editing upstream.
training.checkpoint_policy: Final epoch 100 is the primary checkpoint. The repeatedly observed holdout curve is reported but never used to select a best test epoch.

excluded_diagnostics.mrr: The released evaluator assigns misses rank 2501 rather than zero reciprocal rank.
excluded_diagnostics.hr@5000: The released evaluator searches at most 2500 items, so the synthetic miss rank 2501 makes HR@5000 trivially true.

descriptive_reproduction_tolerance.interpretation: A transparent descriptive gate, not statistical equivalence or evidence for private production claims.

requirements: Audit prepared rows, chronological ordering, held-out targets, item coverage, history lengths, and exact counts
One epoch each for HSTU and SASRec using real official code
Real forward, backward, optimizer, exhaustive evaluation, checkpoint write, and reload
No nonfinite loss or metric; at least 8 GiB observed headroom
Run SASRec, HSTU, and HSTU-large official configurations independently
One GPU per process; no cross-model shared writes
Persist logs, final checkpoints, manifests, and aggregate JSON through one publisher
Report exact batch, sequence, and candidate shapes
Measure independent warm inference and training-step samples
Record precision mode, synchronized wall time, throughput, and peak allocated/reserved memory
Keep unprofiled timing separate from profiler traces
Use the reviewed later upstream commit only after primary evidence is durable
Compare official PyTorch and Triton HSTU attention on A100-compatible shapes
Do not attach later kernel speed to paper-era model quality or HSTU Ultra production claims

review.capability_policy: If the exact model is not offered by the runtime, record that limitation and do not silently substitute another model.
